cases.question: 2018 年每个月的订单量相比 2017 年同期增长了多少？
cases.goldSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS yr,
         EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS mo,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM orders
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT cur.mo AS month,
       cur.cnt - prev.cnt AS yoy_change
FROM monthly cur
JOIN monthly prev ON prev.mo = cur.mo AND prev.yr = 2017
WHERE cur.yr = 2018
ORDER BY cur.mo;
cases.actualSql:
WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS month,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int = 2017) AS orders_2017,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int = 2018) AS orders_2018
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month,
       orders_2017,
       orders_2018,
       orders_2018 - orders_2017 AS growth
FROM monthly_counts
WHERE orders_2018 > 0
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 12;

cases.question: 每个宏观区域下，各会员等级（按等级名称）的商品销售额分别是多少？按销售额从高到低排序。
cases.goldSql:
SELECT r.macro_region, ml.level_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS gmv
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = c.customer_state
JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id
JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY gmv DESC;
cases.actualSql:
SELECT r.macro_region, ml.level_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales
FROM member_levels ml
JOIN members m ON m.level_id = ml.level_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_unique_id = m.customer_unique_id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = s.seller_state
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY sales DESC
LIMIT 100;

cases.question: 库存低于安全库存的商品，按仓库、区域、品牌统计数量，列出前 20。
cases.goldSql:
SELECT w.warehouse_name, r.region_name, b.brand_name, COUNT(*) AS low_stock_items
FROM inventory i
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code
JOIN product_brand_map pbm ON pbm.product_id = i.product_id AND pbm.is_current
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = pbm.brand_id
WHERE i.quantity < i.safety_stock
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY low_stock_items DESC LIMIT 20;
cases.actualSql:
SELECT w.warehouse_name, r.region_name, b.brand_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id) AS product_count
FROM inventory i
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code
LEFT JOIN product_brand_map pbm ON pbm.product_id = i.product_id AND pbm.is_current = true
LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = pbm.brand_id
WHERE i.quantity < i.safety_stock
GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, r.region_code, r.region_name, pbm.brand_id, b.brand_name
ORDER BY product_count DESC, w.warehouse_name, r.region_name, b.brand_name
LIMIT 20;

cases.question: 2017 年和 2018 年各月 GMV 分别是多少？并计算 2018 年相对 2017 年同月的同比增长率。
cases.goldSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS yr,
         EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS mo,
         SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT m18.mo,
       ROUND(m17.gmv, 2) AS gmv_2017,
       ROUND(m18.gmv, 2) AS gmv_2018,
       ROUND(100.0 * (m18.gmv - m17.gmv) / m17.gmv, 2) AS yoy_pct
FROM monthly m18
JOIN monthly m17 ON m17.mo = m18.mo AND m17.yr = 2017
WHERE m18.yr = 2018
ORDER BY m18.mo;
cases.actualSql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS month, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int = 2017 THEN oi.price + oi.freight_value END) AS gmv_2017, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int = 2018 THEN oi.price + oi.freight_value END) AS gmv_2018 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int IN (2017, 2018) GROUP BY 1) SELECT MONTH, ROUND(gmv_2017, 2) AS gmv_2017, ROUND(gmv_2018, 2) AS gmv_2018, ROUND(100.0 * (gmv_2018 - gmv_2017) / NULLIF(gmv_2017, 0), 2) AS yoy_growth_percent FROM monthly ORDER BY MONTH LIMIT 201

cases.question: 退款原因与客户评分的关系：各退款原因对应的平均评分和低分率是多少？
cases.goldSql:
SELECT r.reason_code,
       ROUND(AVG(rev.review_score), 2) AS avg_score,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rev.review_score <= 2) / COUNT(*), 2) AS low_score_pct
FROM refunds r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN order_reviews rev ON rev.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY low_score_pct DESC;
cases.actualSql:
-- 各退款原因下，按评价记录去重后统计平均评分与低分率
WITH reason_reviews AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.reason_code, rev.review_id, rev.review_score
  FROM refunds r
  JOIN order_reviews rev ON rev.order_id = r.order_id
)
SELECT
  reason_code,
  ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_score,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_score <= 2) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS low_score_rate
FROM reason_reviews
GROUP BY reason_code
ORDER BY reason_code
LIMIT 100;
